gen-fs-red-hat-display-gf-suwannaphum: Dignified and editorial, this body face stands tall in the lowercase, like squared-off woodblock type. Suwannaphum gets a lively partner in Red Hat Display, whose constant-width strokes look like glass tubing bent into letters.
gen-fs-red-hat-display-gf-sono: Red Hat Display draws like a marker, daylight showing inside every curve. Sono below has a tall lowercase and wide default spacing, so the bold heading and the approachable sans-serif text sit together easily.
gen-fs-red-hat-display-roboto-slab: Smooth marker lines up top, sturdy slab letters below, and a clear step in height between them. And Red Hat Display's uninterrupted strokes do the loud work, while Roboto Slab's open-throated, middle-heavy lines do the steady reading.
gen-fs-rx-100-fs-bespoke-slab: Futuristic and tightly packed, RX100 has a dominant x-height and zero stroke modulation. Bespoke Slab is grounded and refined with tall lowercase bodies, though it would tire over lengthy paragraphs.
gen-fs-rx-100-fs-trench-slab: Tight, modern and flat-stroked, RX100 gives its y a tail that matches the arm. And Trench Slab, dignified and refined with little gap between lowercase and caps, supplies the quieter text, though not across long paragraphs.
gen-fs-segment-fs-bespoke-slab: Grounded and refined, this serif gives every lowercase letter a tall body and a settled look. Bespoke Slab reads comfortably over a few lines, with Segment's stocky, generously spaced lettering standing above as the commanding voice.
gen-fs-segment-fs-hoover: Hoover is refined and robust, its ascenders compressed. Beneath Segment's widely spaced, stocky heading, the generous entry into Hoover's e keeps the text friendly and clear through brief spells of reading.
gen-fs-segment-fs-karma: Karma is trustworthy and classic, its terminals stopping well short of the stem. And Segment's stocky, widely spaced letters set against Karma's soft modulation add a dependable authority to a few lines.
gen-fs-segment-fs-trench-slab: Dignified and refined, Trench Slab keeps its lowercase close in height to its caps. And Segment grabs attention with stocky, widely spaced letters, while Trench Slab does its best work on a few lines.
gen-fs-sharpie-fs-gambetta: Bookish and graceful, with wide channels into each counter and a gentle shift in stroke weight. Gambetta stays open where Sharpie nearly closes; Sharpie earns its keep big and short, and lengthy paragraphs aren't Gambetta's job.
